visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair, wearing a black sleeveless tank top and a chest-mounted camera rig, holds a cardboard box of Brust protein coffee in a modern kitchen. The kitchen has light wood floors and white cabinetry. (2) He walks up a granite staircase, passing a glass-enclosed display cabinet filled with numerous small toy figurines and gashapon items. (3) On a bed with white and blue linens, he uses his hands to pet a sleeping ginger tabby cat. He wears a silver smartwatch. (4) In a different room, he interacts with a grey and white cat standing near a black automatic pet feeder on a light-colored floor. He picks up a blue and orange bag of 'Greens' cat food and pours some into the bowl. (5) The man changes into a white Los Angeles Dodgers baseball jersey (number 17, Ohtani) and a blue baseball cap. He is in a small hobby room filled with Star Wars memorabilia (R2-D2 model), posters (Wolverine), and a yellow desk chair. (6) He sits in the driver's seat of a white Tesla, buckling his seatbelt. The shot is a wide-angle view through the car's glass roof showing a residential street. (7) Walking outdoors at dusk on a brick-paved sidewalk, the man carries a bucket of 'Fat Daddy' fried chicken and a large bottle of Coca-Cola. (8) He enters a decorated dining room where a young boy with curly hair, also wearing a Dodgers jersey and cap, is crawling on the floor. Balloons spelling 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY' and blue/white balloons are visible. (9) A wall is decorated with numerous printed photos of the boy's growth. A large silver balloon in the shape of the number '5' is present. (10) The family sits around a dining table covered with open pizza boxes, fried chicken, and drinks. (11) The boy sits at the table, intently watching a video on a smartphone showing his own birth. (12) A white birthday cake topped with fresh strawberries is placed on the table with a lit candle. The boy blows out the candle. (13) The boy takes a small square of dark chocolate, bites it, and reacts with a squinted, sour facial expression as he tastes the bitterness.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 人類受難協會. [Logo]: @人類受難協會. [Subtitle]: 這天是happy生日. (2) [Subtitle]: 他這幾天都住在外公外婆家. (3) [Subtitle]: 最近地地震頻繁. (4) [Subtitle]: 家裡的扭蛋櫃早已面目全非. (5) [Subtitle]: 泡妃又在等我上樓. (6) [Subtitle]: 因為她想吃我倒的飼料. (7) [Subtitle]: 阿湯. (8) [Subtitle]: 泡妃還忘了自己是流浪貓. (9) [Subtitle]: 每天都會很職業病地來我房間門口討吃的. (10) [Subtitle]: 但是2樓明明有自動餵食機. (11) [Subtitle]: 她還是喜歡這樣的儀式感. (12) [Subtitle]: 今天岳父給Happy穿了大谷翔平的球帽跟衣服. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以我決定跟他穿父子裝. (14) [Subtitle]: 準備去市區拿披薩跟蛋糕. (15) [Subtitle]: 林太太花店的姑姑會幫Happy佈置生日場地. [Slogan]: #花花花店. (16) [Subtitle]: 大家各司其職準備出發. (17) [Subtitle]: 雖然林太太有訂披薩跟蛋糕. (18) [Subtitle]: 但我還是買了胖老爹. (19) [Subtitle]: 單純只是因為我想吃. (20) [Subtitle]: 他終於完成了他的夢想. (21) [Subtitle]: 林太太說他五歲之後就可以吃巧克力了. (22) [Subtitle]: 他媽媽特地幫他準備了100%的濃巧克力. (23) [Subtitle]: 他吃完的感想是... (24) [Variety]: 有點苦. [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈哈哈.
